title: AdaptiveDatePicker crashes on iOS during date change
body:
Hi,

I'm using `AdaptiveDatePicker` inside of `AlertDialog`. Everything works fine on Android and Desktop, but on iOS I'm experiencing crash as soon as I change day, month or year.

```
calf = "0.6.1"
kotlin = "2.0.21"
compose-plugin = "1.7.0-rc01"
```

Please see attached video and stack trace. Any idea what is wrong here?


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2bdacc21-2fcd-447b-a657-bb87e759786c
